channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, while agencies and crypto firms have frozen more than $2.7 billion.

item.title: US Wins Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Hack Crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts have authorized seizure or restraint of $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: Deutsche Bank opens crypto custody to paying clients
item.description: Deutsche Bank has opened crypto custody to paying clients and signed a pact with Deutsche Asset Management to explore tokenized funds, ETCs and stablecoins.

item.title: Deutsche Bank puts crypto custody service live
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s custody service is live for paying corporate and institutional clients in Europe, putting the bank in charge of selected crypto wallets and keys.

item.title: NYSE taps Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement
item.description: The NYSE plans to use Avalanche ledger technology to clear and settle trades on a tokenized securities venue, linking multiple asset networks to one settlement system.

item.title: NYSE selects Avalanche ledger for tokenized stock platform
item.description: NYSE’s planned digital trading venue will use Avalanche technology for its clearing ledger, linking tokenized shares across networks if regulators approve.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs post $1.28 billion weekly outflow, turn negative
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $1.28 billion in the week to Nov. 6, pushing 2026 flows $914 million negative and marking their heaviest withdrawals since June.

item.title: FinCEN orders U.S. firms to block transfers involving MEXC
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. institutions to block transfers involving MEXC after alleging $16.7 billion in illicit flows, with the rule taking effect 30 days after publication.

item.title: FinCEN orders U.S. financial cutoff for MEXC
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. financial institutions to stop transfers to and from MEXC, citing $16 billion in alleged illicit flows; the order takes effect after publication.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korean hackers stole more than $6 billion from Binance and are converting it to Ether, as authorities urge crypto services to block linked transfers.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance, naming TraderTraitor and urging crypto services to block addresses as funds move toward laundering.

item.title: Matcha Swap Finality: What Support Can Still Do
item.description: A confirmed matcha swap is settled by its chain, so support can trace the record and explain it but usually cannot reverse the transfer alone.

item.title: South Korea Seeks to Push Crypto Tax Start to 2029
item.description: South Korea plans to defer its crypto gains tax from 2027 to 2029, aligning the start with US data exchanges while giving lawmakers time to refine the rules.

item.title: Binance probes intrusion after $6.3B impact estimate
item.description: Binance says a suspected intrusion may have enabled unauthorized withdrawals, with $6.3 billion affected and about $3 billion frozen as its inquiry continues.

item.title: NEAR governance backs 24-month issuance cut to 1.6%
item.description: NEAR’s House of Stake approved a 24-month cut in maximum annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6%; validators must still adopt an upgrade before it takes effect.

item.title: NEAR approves a two-year path to 1.6% issuance
item.description: NEAR's House of Stake approved a plan to lower annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6% over two years, but validators must still adopt the upgrade.

item.title: Binance reopens more withdrawals after $6.3B breach
item.description: Binance began reopening withdrawals for more crypto assets on Nov. 3 after a $6.3 billion wallet breach, restoring access network by network as checks clear.

item.title: How Slippage Tolerance Sets the Floor for Treasury Swaps on Base
item.description: Slippage tolerance sets the minimum tokens a treasury swap may deliver on Base; understand the quote, pool depth and execution limit before approving a trade.

item.title: DTCC Launches Token Service for Securities Held at DTC
item.description: DTCC has launched a service for turning eligible securities held at DTC into wallet-based tokens, with 20 firms signed up and transfers initially limited.

item.title: Binance Suspends Withdrawals After $6.3B Wallet Breach
item.description: Binance says attackers took about $6.3 billion from hot wallets, prompting a withdrawal suspension and a phased restart as it secures systems and covers losses.
